test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the bold and underlined words in the given sentence.

You get a __**good and comprehensive**__* idea* of the town from the clock tower situated in the centre of the town.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Bird's eye view"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Bird's eye view"** is the most appropriate idiom to substitute.
 
• The idiom** "Bird's eye view"** is used to refer to the ability to see something from a very elevated position while viewing a large area below you.
 
 
• **Example:** From the top of this building, you can get a **bird's eye view **of the city.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 3)*** is the correct alternative.
